plan.name: Keep local library migrations retryable
plan.summary: Change only migrateLocalLibrary in lib/history.ts so it marks migration complete and requests deletion of an existing local database only after every local item has been uploaded or found in the shared library under the same kind and name. Opening errors, failed metadata or byte reads (including missing bytes), shared-library listing errors and upload failures must leave the flag unset and the local database intact for another load, with opened connections closed on exit. Preserve the upgrade-needed path that aborts creation and marks a browser with no old library migrated without uploads or deletion, and preserve the no-op behavior for unreadable localStorage or an existing migration flag. Keep oldest-first uploads, existing metadata and byte payloads, and recognition of successful partial uploads on retry; add Vitest acceptance coverage for failures, recovery and these preserved behaviors without changing other history helpers, callers, server behavior or documentation.

tests.name: Opening failures are retried while absent libraries and unavailable storage retain their behavior
tests.says: An IndexedDB open error cannot mark an existing library migrated; the next call uploads its item and completes, while unreadable localStorage, a never-created database and an already-set flag retain their existing behavior.
tests.selector: local library migration distinguishes an open error from an absent library and retries

tests.name: Metadata request errors retain the local library
tests.says: A failed metadata request leaves all local items and the flag untouched, closes the database connection and allows a successful retry.
tests.selector: local library migration retries metadata read failures (request)

tests.name: Metadata transaction exceptions retain the local library
tests.says: An exception opening the metadata transaction is a retryable failure, never an empty successful migration.
tests.selector: local library migration retries metadata read failures (transaction)

tests.name: Metadata store exceptions retain the local library
tests.says: An exception accessing the metadata store preserves the migration source and permits recovery.
tests.selector: local library migration retries metadata read failures (store)

tests.name: Metadata read exceptions retain the local library
tests.says: A synchronous exception from the metadata read preserves the migration source and permits recovery.
tests.selector: local library migration retries metadata read failures (read)

tests.name: Missing item bytes prevent completion
tests.says: An absent blob prevents marking or deleting the local library; after its bytes become readable the retry uploads it and recognizes already-shared items by both kind and name.
tests.selector: local library migration retries byte read failures without repeating successful uploads (missing)

tests.name: Blob request errors prevent completion
tests.says: A failed blob request leaves the entire source library retryable and the retry preserves previously uploaded items.
tests.selector: local library migration retries byte read failures without repeating successful uploads (request)

tests.name: Blob transaction exceptions prevent completion
tests.says: A blob transaction exception cannot silently skip an item or complete migration.
tests.selector: local library migration retries byte read failures without repeating successful uploads (transaction)

tests.name: Blob store exceptions prevent completion
tests.says: A blob store exception keeps the flag unset and all local items intact until a later successful migration.
tests.selector: local library migration retries byte read failures without repeating successful uploads (store)

tests.name: Blob read exceptions prevent completion
tests.says: A synchronous blob read exception keeps the flag unset and all local items intact until a later successful migration.
tests.selector: local library migration retries byte read failures without repeating successful uploads (read)

tests.name: HTTP upload failures remain retryable
tests.says: An unsuccessful upload response prevents completion; a subsequent shared-list failure also preserves local state, and recovery uploads only the missing item with its metadata and bytes intact.
tests.selector: local library migration retries partial uploads and a failed shared listing (http)

tests.name: Rejected upload requests remain retryable
tests.says: A rejected upload request prevents completion; subsequent retries preserve earlier uploads and finish only when every local item is shared.
tests.selector: local library migration retries partial uploads and a failed shared listing (network)
